snippet.title: HITM3 - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
HITM3 is out now!

You can find it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2709190/HITM3/

Help your love Dei make his own movie. Sell empanadas to fund the film or discover the dark origin of your relationship. HITM3 is a third person, slice of life adventure where you control Nam on his days in Santiago de Chile. 

Features
- A soundtrack with tracks by Lia Nadja, Niñosindigo, Lavina Yelb, leorina, paltamango, Vicente Palma & mariapepinos.
- Reimagined movies from Raúl Ruiz, Shuji Terayama & Bruce LaBruce.
- 2 - 4 hours of gameplay.
